name: Atomic Slider Addons for Elementor
author: WP Caliph

sections.description:
Atomic Slider is a feature-rich plugin crafted to supercharge the Elementor page builder with advanced slider widgets that are both powerful and easy to use. Ideal for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, Atomic Slider enables you to create visually stunning, fully responsive sliders that enhance user engagement and elevate your website’s design.

Whether you’re building a blog, an online store, or a business website, Atomic Slider gives you complete control over your content presentation with highly customizable sliders. The plugin offers:

🎯 Dynamic Content Sliders – Automatically pull content from your blog posts, products, or custom post types into elegant, animated sliders.

🛒 WooCommerce Product Sliders – Showcase your products with beautifully designed carousels and promotional sliders that increase conversions.

🎥 Video & Image Sliders – Add multimedia-rich sliders with smooth transitions, lightbox options, and autoplay controls.

🖼️ Hero Sliders – Create impactful landing sections with full-width hero sliders and interactive call-to-action buttons.

💡 Atomic Slider – Powerful Widgets for Elementor

Atomic Slider extends Elementor with a set of lightweight, performance-focused widgets designed to enhance your website’s creativity and usability — without sacrificing speed.

😍 Elementor widgets

✅ Image Carousel – A coverflow-filled Swiper effect that brings your slides to life.
✅ Super Flow – A smooth, animated slider with advanced flow effects and seamless transitions.
✅ Showcase – Hero section Showcase slider.

More widgets and features are comming soon…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload atomic-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Atomic Slider along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential widgets to help you create your blogging site in minutes.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support

  • When we release a update version, then automatically you will get a notification on WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there. Thereafter you want to update manually just knock us, we will send you update version via mail.
